text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a research study focused on simulating future urban land expansion—a form of land use/land cover (LULC) prediction—at the national scale of China. It explicitly covers the entire country as the study area and uses an improved LUSD-urban model integrating localized Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) and a convolutional neural network (CNN). The study implements multiple future scenarios (five SSPs) with quantitative comparisons of urban expansion and resulting natural habitat loss. It reports spatially explicit modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., OA = 99.45%, Kappa = 0.73, FoM = 0.26), and outputs include mapped projections of urban land from 2020 to 2050. Although impacts on natural habitats are evaluated, LULC (urban) prediction is the central research objective and methodological foundation, satisfying all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
